title: Formal partial derivatives of polynomials
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$. For $i=1,\dots,n$ the *formal partial derivative* $\partial/\partial x_i:P\to P$ is the unique $R$-linear map with $\partial/\partial x_i(fg)=f\,\partial g/\partial x_i+g\,\partial f/\partial x_i$ (an $R$-derivation of $P$ into $P$) and $\partial x_j/\partial x_i=\delta_{ij}$; explicitly, $\partial/\partial x_i(r\,x_1^{e_1}\cdots x_n^{e_n})=e_i\,r\,x_1^{e_1}\cdots x_i^{e_i-1}\cdots x_n^{e_n}$ (zero if $e_i=0$), extended additively.
